S.FORM: == Takaray a sowal == maramod O maramod hananay no 'Amis ko nika lacecay no fa'inayan ato fafahiyan. O tata'akayay a demak no lalafo no loma' ko nika raramod i niyaro'. Patala ko fa'elohay a mararamoday to titi no fafoy ato epah a pakaen to lalomaan no loma'. Matatakitakid ato masasipa'icep ko fa'elohay a maramoday. Mitolon a palemed ko faki to fa'elohay mararamoday ato nipainian. Masalipa:NoteTA 導言 Ono 'Amis a mararamod hananay i, o tadamaanay a sa'opo no 'Amis a finacadan, o kafana'an to matrilineal a sa'osi. itini i rayray no to'as, o fafahiyan ko mitongoday to tatirengan, pakayni i fafahi a mikadafo ato fafahi ko mitongoday to lekakawa, o loma' no fafahi i, o mato'asay ko mitongoden to fafahiay a wawa ano eca o matatodongay a teloc no fafahian. itini tona rayray no rayray no 'a'amisan, caay ko no fa'inayan ato fafahian a faloco' ko pararamod, o pakayniay to tayal no laloma'an, o tayal no niyaro' no niyaro'. caay ka lecad to no payrang a finacadan ko "piala to fafahi" hananay a harateng, o no pangcah a demak i, o "pialaay to fa'inayan" ko sapikadafo. ikor no pikadafo no fa'inayay a fa'inayn i, malinah tayra i fafahiyan a loma', malawawa no fafahifahiyan, pakayni i loma' no fafafahiyan mifalic to halafinay a tayal a sakanga'ay no 'orip ato sakacifaloco' no finacadan. talacowa mihakelong to no aniniay ato no holamin kowan kwan kwan kwan kwan a lekakawa, adihay to ko kasasiromaroma no kararamod no anini a pangcah, nika itini i ilisin a tata'akay a lisin, mahapinang to ko pinangan no fafa'inayan ato fa'inangay a demak. "家"(Luma'),而"家" o sa'ayaway a lalosidan no 'amis i, o loma', o fafahiyan ko saka'orip no loma', ano caay katatodong ko sakakaay a fafahi i, o fa'inayan ko cacitodong to 'orip no fafahi. S.PHON: == takaraj a so~uwaɾ == maramo~uɬ~ɮ o~u maramo~uɬ~ɮ ħananaj no~u ʡamis ko~u nika ɾaʦəʦaj no~u faʡinajan ato~u fafaħijan. o~u tataʡakajaj a ɬ~ɮəmak no~u ɾaɾafo~u no~u ɾo~umaʡ ko~u nika raramo~uɬ~ɮ i nijaro~uʡ. pataɾa ko~u faʡəɾo~uħaj a mararamo~uɬ~ɮaj to~u titi no~u fafo~uj ato~u əpaħ a pakaən to~u ɾaɾo~umaan no~u ɾo~umaʡ. matatakitakiɬ~ɮ ato~u masasipaʡiʦəp ko~u faʡəɾo~uħaj a maramo~uɬ~ɮaj. mito~uɾo~un a paɾəməɬ~ɮ ko~u faki to~u faʡəɾo~uħaj mararamo~uɬ~ɮaj ato~u nipainian. masaɾipa:no~utəta ** o~uno~u ʡamis a mararamo~uɬ~ɮ ħananaj i, o~u taɬ~ɮamaanaj a saʡo~upo~u no~u ʡamis a finaʦaɬ~ɮan, o~u kafanaʡan to~u matriɾinəaɾ a saʡo~usi. itini i rajraj no~u to~uʡas, o~u fafaħijan ko~u mito~uŋo~uɬ~ɮaj to~u tatirəŋan, pakajni i fafaħi a mikaɬ~ɮafo~u ato~u fafaħi ko~u mito~uŋo~uɬ~ɮaj to~u ɾəkakawa, o~u ɾo~umaʡ no~u fafaħi i, o~u mato~uʡasaj ko~u mito~uŋo~uɬ~ɮən to~u fafaħiaj a wawa ano~u əʦa o~u matato~uɬ~ɮo~uŋaj a təɾo~uʦ no~u fafaħian. itini to~una rajraj no~u rajraj no~u ʡaʡamisan, ʦaaj ko~u no~u faʡinajan ato~u fafaħian a faɾo~uʦo~uʡ ko~u pararamo~uɬ~ɮ, o~u pakajniaj to~u tajaɾ no~u ɾaɾo~umaʡan, o~u tajaɾ no~u nijaro~uʡ no~u nijaro~uʡ. ʦaaj ka ɾəʦaɬ~ɮ to~u no~u pajraŋ a finaʦaɬ~ɮan ko~u "piaɾa to~u fafaħi" ħananaj a ħaratəŋ, o~u no~u paŋʦaħ a ɬ~ɮəmak i, o~u "piaɾaaj to~u faʡinajan" ko~u sapikaɬ~ɮafo~u. iko~ur no~u pikaɬ~ɮafo~u no~u faʡinajaj a faʡinajn i, maɾinaħ tajra i fafaħijan a ɾo~umaʡ, maɾawawa no~u fafaħifaħijan, pakajni i ɾo~umaʡ no~u fafafaħijan mifaɾiʦ to~u ħaɾafinaj a tajaɾ a sakaŋaʡaj no~u ʡo~urip ato~u sakaʦifaɾo~uʦo~uʡ no~u finaʦaɬ~ɮan. taɾaʦo~uwa miħakəɾo~uŋ to~u no~u aniniaj ato~u no~u ħo~uɾamin ko~uwan kwan kwan kwan kwan a ɾəkakawa, aɬ~ɮiħaj to~u ko~u kasasiro~umaro~uma no~u kararamo~uɬ~ɮ no~u anini a paŋʦaħ, nika itini i iɾisin a tataʡakaj a ɾisin, maħapinaŋ to~u ko~u pinaŋan no~u fafaʡinajan ato~u faʡinaŋaj a ɬ~ɮəmak.
